message.text:
Identifying the SSE hub implementation and the specific memo handlers that broadcast live events.

CreateMemo, DeleteMemo, UpdateMemo, and CreateMemoComment broadcast SSE events directly. SetMemoAttachments and SetMemoRelations trigger updates indirectly through helper services.

UpsertMemoReaction and DeleteMemoReaction are reaction handlers, not memo handlers. SetMemoAttachments and SetMemoRelations trigger memo.updated side effects via dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects. The SSE mechanism and hub location will be confirmed by reading sse_handler.go.

Memo handlers broadcast through SSEHub.Broadcast.

CreateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, UpdateMemo, SetMemoAttachments, and SetMemoRelations broadcast via SSEHub.Broadcast. UpsertMemoReaction and DeleteMemoReaction also broadcast, though they are reaction handlers rather than memo handlers.

All handlers are MemoService RPC handlers.

Direct SSE broadcasts come from CreateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, UpsertMemoReaction, and DeleteMemoReaction. UpdateMemo, SetMemoAttachments, and SetMemoRelations broadcast via dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects.

The mechanism is SSE at /api/v1/sse. The hub is implemented in server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go.

q20.

SSE (Server-Sent Events); server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go; CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, UpsertMemoReaction, DeleteMemoReaction

**Mechanism:** Server-Sent Events. Clients connect to `GET /api/v1/sse` with `Content-Type: text/event-stream` (`server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go`, registered from `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`).

**Hub:** `SSEHub` is defined in `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` (`NewSSEHub`, `Subscribe`, `Broadcast`).

**Memo handlers that broadcast:**

| Handler | Event | File |
|---------|-------|------|
| `CreateMemo` | `memo.created` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` |
| `DeleteMemo` | `memo.deleted` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` |
| `CreateMemoComment` | `memo.comment.created` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go` |
| `UpdateMemo` | `memo.updated` (via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`) | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` → `memo_update_helpers.go` |
| `SetMemoAttachments` | `memo.updated` (via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`) | `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go` |
| `SetMemoRelations` | `memo.updated` (via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`) | `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go` |
| `UpsertMemoReaction` | `reaction.upserted` | `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go` |
| `DeleteMemoReaction` | `reaction.deleted` | `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go` |
